correctness.rationale: Smoothness yields x perp_B y iff sum x_i^3 y_i=0, and all unit ordered pairs reduce to one real r=s^4 in [0,1] and two y signs. Exact quartic norm identities give F(r,t)=J(r)+(3/2)J(r)^2t+[J-(9/2)JS+(7/2)J^3]t^2+O(t^3) uniformly. Here J=r^(1/4)(1-r)/(1-r+r^2)^(3/4) uniquely maximizes at r0=2-sqrt3; J(r0)^4=4/27, S(r0)^2=1/3, J"/J=-7/2-2sqrt3<0. Independently symbolically checked these identities and P/J=1-13sqrt3/18, -P'/J"=3sqrt3-6 with exact algebra. Uniform convergence excludes other r and opposite y sign; local strict concavity and the implicit function theorem yield analytic unique r_t with no linear shift and quadratic displacement. Coefficients D_t=c+t/sqrt3+c(1-13sqrt3/18)t^2 follow, not just numerical fits.
